title: Mammoth in an ice cube
prompt: I’d like a cartoony wooly mammoth frozen in a giant ice cube. Its eyes should be closed and it should have long luscious eyelashes. In fact, let’s go ahead and give it some eye shadow too so that it is a female wooly mammoth.

responses.notes: Generated via clean-context subagent; standard technical appendix v1 appended to the prompt. Ink-bounds check passed — worst dead margin 1.6%. The only response to build the cube in three dimensions: separate front, top, and right faces, each with its own gradient, cracks, bubbles, and clip path, with the mammoth clipped into the front face and a blurred brown smear on the right face standing in for the body seen through the ice. Six lashes per eye and a pink-to-violet gradient lid with a lighter crease highlight. Fur is drawn as scalloped silhouettes plus strand strokes clipped to body, head, and trunk. Kept as the drawer’s display by owner call (2026-08-30) — a legacy favorite, hand-filed on the current rubric (UA top, SC middle, Layering middle, JNSQ top; grade already Choice); the rerun set stands as the comparison.

The mammoth fills the frame corner to corner, so the ice reads more as a tinted pane than as a giant cube around it.
